AirForce Delta Storm.name: AirForce Delta Storm
AirForce Delta Storm.summary: Strap into your cockpit and blast through the gut-wrenching world of flight combat. Your adrenaline pumps as machine gun fire pelts off your tail, you execute back-breaking barrel rolls and experience dog-fighting action. Take your pick of over 70 planes, including military fighters rendered from actual aircraft. With a full range of extreme missions to numb your senses, AirForce Delta Storm pushes your Xbox to the sky!

Driv3r.name: Driv3r
Driv3r.summary: Driv3r for Game Boy Advance brings the action-packed experience of the renowned console series to handheld gaming. Step into the shoes of undercover cop Tanner as you navigate through intense missions across sprawling cities like Miami, Nice, and Istanbul. The game offers a blend of high-speed car chases, on-foot pursuits, and shootouts, all rendered in impressive graphics. With a gripping storyline, diverse missions, and a variety of vehicles to commandeer, Driv3r on GBA captures the essence of the original while delivering an engaging experience on the go.

Fruits Mura no Doubutsu-tachi.name: Fruits-mura no Doubutsu-tachi
Fruits Mura no Doubutsu-tachi.summary: Fruits-mura no Doubutsu-tachi is a cutesy collection of mini-games and events for one player. You build up your relationship with a group of friends who've come from across the seas to Fruits Village.

Sakura Momoko no UkiUki Carnival.name: Sakura Momoko no Ukiuki Carnival
Sakura Momoko no UkiUki Carnival.summary: A Game Boy Advance life simulation game developed by Indies Zero and published by Nintendo exclusively in Japan.

Wagamama Fairy Mirumo de Pon! - Ougon Ma.name: Wagamama Fairy: Mirumo de Pon! Ougon Maracas no Densetsu
Wagamama Fairy Mirumo de Pon! - Ougon Ma.summary: A GBA game released by Konami in December 2002. It is the first video game adaptation made for Mirumo de Pon.
